instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot at eye-level. In a wooded park, the man in the blue short-sleeved shirt (R1) and the woman in the grey blazer (R2) walk side-by-side on a dirt path. The man (R1) is on the left, walking forward with a smile, while the woman (R2) on the right looks toward him as they walk. They hold hands, with his left hand clasped in her right hand. Soft natural daylight filters through the trees, highlighting the green foliage and earthy path.
